attributes.board_name: West Virginia Board of Examiners in Counseling

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs by Board-approved providers, Board-approved/post-approved programs, AAMFT pre-approved programs and home study (home study max 20 h), accredited MFT graduate courses (15 h per semester hour), publications (article 10 h, book 30 h), presentations (max 10 h). Max 15 h from employing-agency presenters; at least 20 h from offerings not presented by the licensee.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First two CE bienniums: licensee submits the recording form and all certificates with the renewal; afterwards random audit (27CSR10 s.3.2-3.3).
rules.carryover: Excess contact hours may not be carried over.
rules.audit_note: From the third biennium, random audits (documents within 15 working days); automatic audit after a prior non-compliance; keep records 6 years.

topics.who: MFT-related ethics; first renewal must be a formal program with an approved presenter
Mental health conditions of veterans and their families

rules.legal_basis: W. Va. Code R. 27CSR10 (Marriage and Family Therapist License Renewal and Continuing Professional Education Requirements, eff. 7/1/2017)
rules.notes: License renews annually by June 30; CE reported per biennium (July 1 - June 30, starting 2016-2018). An amendment to 27CSR10 is listed as in progress at the WV Secretary of State.
